body:
## Why

Manifest sync to `stranske/trip-planner#1869` is blocked on unresolved bot review threads for the keepalive loop reporter workflow copied from Workflows.

## Scope

Fix the Workflows source template on `main` so the next sync regeneration outdates consumer threads on `.github/workflows/agents-keepalive-loop-reporter.yml`.

## Tasks

- [ ] Update `templates/consumer-repo/.github/workflows/agents-keepalive-loop-reporter.yml` on `main` to resolve the upstream review debt blocking `stranske/trip-planner#1869`.
- [ ] Test `pytest tests/workflows/test_keepalive_authority_delivery.py::test_gate_paths_deny_invalid_claims_and_reporters_can_persist_generation -q` on `main` after the template workflow change; capture literal pass output in the PR description.
- [ ] Open a Workflows PR that merges the template fix and note the expected consumer manifest path `.github/workflows/agents-keepalive-loop-reporter.yml` for the follow-on sync PR.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `pytest tests/workflows/test_keepalive_authority_delivery.py::test_gate_paths_deny_invalid_claims_and_reporters_can_persist_generation -q` exits 0 on `main` after updating `templates/consumer-repo/.github/workflows/agents-keepalive-loop-reporter.yml`.
- [ ] A merged Workflows PR updates `templates/consumer-repo/.github/workflows/agents-keepalive-loop-reporter.yml` and links `stranske/trip-planner#1869`.
- [ ] After consumer sync regeneration, bot review threads on `stranske/trip-planner` path `.github/workflows/agents-keepalive-loop-reporter.yml` are outdated or marked resolved (link the sync PR URL).

title: [sync-review] Fix upstream manifest-synced paths blocking stranske/trip-planner#1869
